goal: Close the two gaps found in the 2026-10-06 V1.2 runs: (1) the operator parsed an exported sheet file and empty cells became bare numbers ("259", "261", "267"), which readback passed through and decide fingerprinted; (2) applications Bora submits outside a Career OS package (Handshake Quick apply) had no CLI path to the Ledger.
acceptance_conditions: readback refuses any bare-number cell (the whole cell is digits and nothing else, checked with a full match) in JOBS, APPLICATIONS, LOG and NETWORK (except NETWORK Notes) with READBACK_SUSPECT_NUMERIC_CELL; all V1.2 readback behaviour is unchanged otherwise.

record-external-submit requires --bora-confirmed, an existing single JOBS row, a real calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, channel/resume/evidence notes that are non-empty and contain no Unicode control, format or line/paragraph separator characters, a resume note with nothing hash-like (no 'sha' followed by digits in any spelling and no run of 32+ hex characters), and no existing APPLICATIONS row or APPLICATION_RECORDED LOG event for the job on any date; it emits the exact 10-column APPLICATIONS row with Resume_Version 'EXTERNAL_NO_CAREER_OS_PACKAGE | <note>' (never a hash) and Cover_Letter_Version NOT_RECORDED, a JOBS update of Application_Status only, and an exact 9-column LOG row.

closeout treats a submitted role whose single APPLICATIONS row starts with EXTERNAL_NO_CAREER_OS_PACKAGE as complete without plan, folder or resume hash; every other submitted role keeps all existing checks.
No change to decide, pursuit-state, package, slate, the pursuit gate, the network CLI or the cloud adapter.
Runbook and config document both changes and the read-values-only rule; contract id is CAREER_OS_RUN_CONTRACT_V1_3.
review_requirements: STOP after one PR is opened. Do not merge until Bora obtains a fresh independent read-only SAFE review.
stop_conditions: Any need to let an external submission claim a Career OS resume hash, or to relax closeout for ordinary submissions.
Any change to the pursuit gate or decision semantics.
Any need to write Drive/Sheets from this engineering PR.
human_approval_requirements: Bora retains merge authority, confirms every submission, and makes every decision and Ledger write.
